info.title: PalOps API
info.description: Server-owned raw-data API for one self-hosted Palworld dedicated server. Read models use resource paths; state changes create durable operations under domain-specific /ops namespaces. Complete collections are intentionally unpaginated so clients can calculate rankings locally. To protect gameplay, PalOps may retain stale same-world observations or reject excess complete-dataset reads with 503 and Retry-After.

200.description: The exact OpenAPI contract embedded in this build.

AdminPassword.description: Username admin and the current Palworld AdminPassword.

NotModified.description: The retained complete representation is unchanged.

Problem.description: Stable problem details. A gameplay-protection overload response may include Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retrying a rejected request.

PlayerLeaderboard.description: Complete unpaginated raw player ranking inputs. Response size and client processing time grow with the Active World Dataset; retain the response, revalidate with ETag, and avoid frequent polling. PalOps currently serves the identity JSON representation.

PalOps-Dataset-ID.description: Common generation identifier shared by related raw collections.

dataset_cache_error.description: Persistence or validation error for the durable same-world raw dataset cache.

dataset_refresh_error.description: Latest incremental Unreal collection failure; the previous complete generation is retained as stale.

worker_count.description: At least two workers are required so PalOps can reserve one worker for lightweight health and operator traffic while complete datasets are streaming.

audit_recorded.description: False only when the configuration was committed but its audit record could not be persisted.
